subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should OpenClaw adopt 16 MiB as the hard maximum for marketplace manifests, accepting that larger existing manifests will stop loading?
rationale: The patch safely fixes unbounded allocation, but repository evidence does not establish a previously approved maximum manifest size, so the compatibility boundary requires owner intent.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB boundary
options.body: Adopt the proposed limit, refresh the branch against current main, and land the bounded-read hardening with the existing proof and tests.

options.title: Choose a different maximum
options.body: Set an owner-approved higher limit or derive a shared manifest limit, then update the focused boundary tests and user-facing error accordingly.

options.title: Pause the hard cap
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers can quantify real marketplace manifest sizes and select a compatibility threshold.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed limit, refresh the branch against current main, and land the bounded-read hardening with the existing proof and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The marketplace loader and its user-facing compatibility behavior originate from their merged feature work.
